measurement_basis: Published annual tables after internal FBI data-quality review; agency tables limited by publication rules such as 12 months of complete offense data.
revision_behavior: Generally stable annual release artifacts; superseded when the next annual publication is issued rather than continuously drifting.
why_counts_can_differ: Can exclude data that remain present in master/open-data style files; uses publication-specific inclusion rules and estimated/trended outputs in some tables.
practical_v2_use: Canonical FBI publication-style annual controls; published agency tables; historical continuity when staying in the publication lane.
do_not_use_for: Raw reported-universe engineering; ORI roster policy; direct comparison to raw incident/master counts without lane alignment.
source_priority_rule: If the question is what the FBI published for year X, stay in this lane end-to-end.

measurement_basis: Dynamic web queries and interactive summaries, including mixed summarized views for violent/property trends and hierarchy-rule style query logic in some discovery paths.
revision_behavior: Can move as monthly updates arrive; explicit publication pauses occur around annual release processing.
why_counts_can_differ: Dynamic timestamped surface; summarized/query logic differs from publication tables and from raw incident/master files.
practical_v2_use: Monitoring, anomaly triage, quick official lookups, ORI/name spot checks, and explanation of unexpected spikes.
do_not_use_for: Canonical annual input controls or stable historical series construction.
source_priority_rule: Use only for monitoring and reconciliation context unless the specific dynamic query output is itself the intended product surface.

measurement_basis: All reported data retained in incident/master/open-data files; raw or master-style engineering surfaces.
revision_behavior: Can update when source files are refreshed; year-to-date files are explicitly provisional.
why_counts_can_differ: Includes reported data that publication tables may omit; incident/master grain differs from summarized publication displays.
practical_v2_use: Raw engineering continuity, ORI-level NIBRS support, incident/offense/victim/property detail, pre-publication monitoring.
do_not_use_for: Blind publication-table replication or direct comparison to publication totals without applying the right summarization and eligibility rules.
source_priority_rule: Use annual state NIBRS or annual master files for raw engineering; avoid YTD files for stable releases.

measurement_basis: Metadata about agencies, NIBRS participation dates, and state-year coverage/population, not crime totals.
revision_behavior: Roster can change as participation status changes; participation datasets summarize by state-year.
why_counts_can_differ: Raw is_nibrs is current participation, not necessarily year-effective participation; participation counts agencies reporting in any format and do not identify the crime-measurement surface.
practical_v2_use: ORI validation, agency-type metadata, county grouping, effective-year NIBRS auditing, coverage context and denominators.
do_not_use_for: Crime totals, offense controls, or blind year-specific source selection without start-date logic.
source_priority_rule: Derive effective-year NIBRS from nibrs_start_date; use participation only as state-year context.

measurement_basis: Weighted and imputed estimates designed for the NIBRS-only era, accounting for nonresponse, partial-year reporting, and missing incident detail.
revision_behavior: Current endpoints can revise prior years; archive endpoints preserve originally published values.
why_counts_can_differ: This is an estimate family, not a reported-count family; suppression and uncertainty rules can hide or revise values.
practical_v2_use: Official 2021+ estimate benchmarks when V2 intentionally wants the BJS/FBI estimate series.
do_not_use_for: Legacy FBI SRS estimate continuity, city raw counts, or agency-level reconciliation.
source_priority_rule: Keep this lane separate from both publication-table reported counts and raw incident/master counts.

lane_label: Secondary official analytic surfaces using NIBRS
measurement_basis: NIBRS-based exploratory analytics with LEARCAT-specific coverage and offense-definition rules.
revision_behavior: Updates as BJS refreshes the tool and methodology.
why_counts_can_differ: Coverage limited to full-reporter states for rates; some offense definitions differ from CDE.
practical_v2_use: Secondary reconciliation, exploratory pattern checks, and additional context on NIBRS-only states and agencies.
do_not_use_for: Authoritative count matching to CDE/FBI publication tables or universal-rate production inputs.
source_priority_rule: Treat as a secondary analytic tool, not a canonical control surface.

measurement_basis: Reference framing and archival taxonomy, often linking to FBI, BJS, ICPSR, or OpenICPSR holdings.
revision_behavior: Changes as guides and catalogs are updated.
why_counts_can_differ: Not the authoritative publisher for current official numeric surfaces; may mix official and derivative references for teaching or archival convenience.
practical_v2_use: Context on component structure, archival lanes, county/statewide allocation conventions, and legacy file families.
do_not_use_for: Official numeric authority or direct V2 input source selection.
source_priority_rule: Use these to understand the ecosystem, then go back to the official surface for the actual input lane.
